description: Input contract for unity/Emulator. A deterministic replay of raw hand frames (OpenXR gives 26 joint poses; v1 classifiers read the palm = joint 0). Each frame carries an expectedGesture label so the emulator can score detections: exactly one expected detection per labeled segment, zero false positives elsewhere.

fps.description: Frame rate the stream was authored at (sample: 90).

expectedGesture.description: Gesture the scenario intends. 'None' frames must produce zero detections (idle, too-slow / too-short swipes).

joints.description: 26 joints, index 0 = palm (XRHandJointID.Palm). Each joint is [x, y, z] in metres, head space.

label.description: Scenario label, e.g. 'swipe_right'. Contiguous frames with the same label and expectedGesture form a scored segment.

tracked.description: False = hand lost; classifiers must reset state.

title: Gesture stream — synthetic 26-joint input for the LayerSwitcher emulator
